actions.reason: K8_C0001 has an interpretable biological identity (coherent metabolic-down RNA phenotype and a PBRM1/VHL-mutant-prevalent mutation profile), but identity alone does not establish independent membership. Its set-level current-label alignment is near zero in all four modalities with no consistent within-versus-between distinction (silhouettes 0.022/-0.067/-0.038, and between-set distances smaller than within-set in RNA, WSI, and WXS), so the current membership is not positively represented as a separate unit. No split is supported (partition screen uniformly candidate_k=1 with no feasible k>=2 solution), and no merge was justified for this candidate. Independent retention is therefore unsupported and decision-relevant evidence is exhausted.

K8_C0002 has a coherent biological identity (immune-down/metabolic-up RNA phenotype and VHL-depleted/TP53-enriched mutation profile) and modest positive set-level alignment, but the pair-level structural review of its closest boundary (K8_C0002-K8_C0003) shows an essentially zero boundary silhouette (0.00045) with between-set affinity only marginally below within-set, and a union dominated by the single-cluster resolution. The weak boundary and single-cluster-dominated union are compatible with removing the boundary, but they do not positively establish K8_C0002 as an independent unit, and no merge was justified. With membership independence unresolved and structural rescue exhausted, retention is unsupported.
